trailhead.label: The village square (Plaz) in Zuoz, the board’s start

cautions: Village streets in Zuoz, including a short stretch of the main street: lead short for passing cars.
Steep cobbled lanes in the old village.
Hay meadows are closed in the growing season: keep to the track.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
